caveats: All ten are law firms in one town, so scores are relative to each other, not to the wider market. Legal fees are mid-to-high ticket but the firms here are mostly small.

Google review counts were only displayed for five profiles (Allen 48, Broderick 53, RAM Law 148, Blinder 99, Goodwin 12). For the others Maps served a limited view showing the star rating without a count.

benedictandaltman.com and win-good.com both returned a bare '403 Unauthorized' page to a normal automated Chrome session on every URL tried; their entries are based on text fetches and the sitemap rather than a rendered page, and say so.

Two inference calls are flagged in-line: the Broderick New Brunswick suite reading as a satellite/meeting address, and the Shamy municipal public-defender work (search-result titles only, PDFs not opened).
The batch address for Jay Weinberg (149 Livingston Ave) is outdated - the firm's own site says it now operates from 24 North 3rd Avenue, Suite 200.
Reviewers' names are omitted and reviews are paraphrased rather than quoted.
data_gaps: Review counts for Rodriguez, Benedict Altman and Nettl, Hendricks & Hendricks and Shamy & Shamy were not exposed in the Google Maps view I could reach.
Benedict Altman and Nettl and Robert H Goodwin sites were not visually inspected or screenshotted at 390px because of the 403 responses; their contact-form fields and schema could not be verified.

I did not submit any form, so I cannot confirm whether a CAPTCHA appears before submission on the Rodriguez, Allen, Weinberg, Broderick, RAM Law, Blinder or Hendricks forms (no submissions were made, per the no-outreach rule).
robots.txt was not opened for theallenlawfirmnj.com, jayweinberg.com, brandonjbroderick.com, blinderlaw.com or shamyandshamy.com (the last failed TLS).
No pricing or fee data is published by any firm in this batch, so 'answerable' scoring could not credit price ranges to anyone.

Ownership/claim status of the Google profiles could only be inferred from whether Google showed a 'Claim this business' prompt; Rodriguez, Hendricks and Shamy showed no claim prompt but their claim status was not independently confirmed.
